name: localized₀_inf
statement: (M' ⊓ M'').localized₀ p f = M'.localized₀ p f ⊓ M''.localized₀ p f

name: localized₀_iSup
statement: Type*} (g : ι → Submodule R M) : (⨆ i, g i).localized₀ p f = ⨆ i, (g i).localized₀ p f

name: localizedEquiv
statement: M'.localized p ≃ₗ[Localization p] LocalizedModule p M'

name: localizedQuotientEquiv
statement: (LocalizedModule p M ⧸ M'.localized p) ≃ₗ[Localization p] LocalizedModule p (M ⧸ M')
